metadata.description: Skills built from real projects: verify before claiming done, break debugging loops, keep your skill setup lean, trustworthy document extraction, Make.com automation, honest ML evaluation, hackathon sprints, Android device testing and exam revision sheets.

plugins.name: all-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in this repo in one install: done-gate, loop-breaker, skill-scout, doc-extraction, make-automation, honest-model-eval, hackathon-sprint, android-device-test and exam-sheet.

plugins.name: senior-pack
plugins.description: Starter pack for working engineers: done-gate, loop-breaker, skill-scout, doc-extraction, make-automation and honest-model-eval in one install.

plugins.name: student-pack
plugins.description: Starter pack for students: hackathon-sprint, exam-sheet, done-gate and loop-breaker in one install.

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Verification gate before any work is reported done: the asks rebuilt from the user's words, file:line evidence, a blind subagent audit, and the project's own checks.

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Get out of a debugging loop: stop editing, reproduce by hand, test every assumption, prove the root cause with evidence, then hand off to a fresh session if needed.

plugins.name: skill-scout
plugins.description: Find skills that fit your project on GitHub (ranked by fit, health and stars, with their open issues), prune the ones you never use, and propose new ones from what you repeat.

plugins.name: doc-extraction
plugins.description: Document extraction you can trust: text layer first, OCR with page-to-page context, validators that decide what is correct, one adapter per layout, and human review.

plugins.name: make-automation
plugins.description: Make.com automations done right: when to use Make, Python or both, webhooks between them, Teams and other painful APIs, human approval, dedupe, dry runs and error handling.

plugins.name: honest-model-eval
plugins.description: Keep ML models honest: audit the data first, a prediction-time contract against leakage, time-based splits, market baselines, calibration, and a data-audit script.

plugins.name: hackathon-sprint
plugins.description: Build to win a hackathon with an AI agent: pick the category, mine open source first, scope to one flawless demo path, deploy for real, and nail the deck and demo.

plugins.name: android-device-test
plugins.description: Test an Android app on a real phone over adb: install, tap real UI elements, kill the network and the process, report pass or fail with screenshots and logcat.

plugins.name: exam-sheet
plugins.description: Turn a syllabus and past papers into one printable revision page, chapters ranked by the marks they actually carried, every topic an exam-ready answer with a diagram.
